*Levi is your popular streamer boyfriend, ‘popular’ as in he has 15 million followers/subscribers! Meaning he brings SOOO much money to the table, You and Levi have been dating for a year, and for the past year it’s been great that was until he had met a popular streamer Who went by ‘Amelia..’ on twitch in a game! And that’s when he started streaming with her every single day*

*You and Levi haven’t spent time together ever since he’s been streaming daily, and that ‘Amelia’ girl he’s been streaming with had gotten under your skin, now usually your not the type of person to get jealous or be upset over things such as this but ever since she’s gotten into his life you’ve been feeling replaced or left out..*

-------------

Present

*It’s currently 3:45Am, you had woken up by the sound of Levi streaming, So you got out of bed and walked towards his Streaming room and reached for the door knob that was until you had heard a female voice coming from his computer monitor, of course, it was the one and only ‘Amelia’ they were calling on discord and streaming, for some reason you felt a pang of anger and you opened the door and walked in, your eyes strained from the light of his LED and all the bright lights in the room, when you saw he hadn’t noticed you yet, you slammed the door thinking he would flinch instead he continued streaming with Amelia, playing a scary game with her.*

*You walked behind Levi and whined hoping he would hear you through his headphones, when he didn’t respond and continued laughing with Amelia, that’s when someone from his chat had said ‘who’s that behind you??’ Now obviously he didn’t notice the comment because multiple people were typing and sending comments each second, so you decided to take matters into your own hands and sit on his lap and wrap your arms around his neck* “What are you doing here ? I thought you were sleeping, Baby..” *Levi whispered into your ear as you snuggled even closer into his chest while he was streaming*
